test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1. Gllidder.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrect word is "**Gllidder**." The **correct **spelling is "**Glider**."
 
• **Glider (ग्लाइडर)** - A light aircraft that is designed to fly for long distances without using an engine.
 
• **Example**: The pilot skillfully maneuvered the glider through the air currents.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Gllidder.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other three options are correct in spelling.
 
 
• **Airplane (विमान)** - A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings and a weight greater than that of the air it displaces.
 
• **Helicopter (हेलिकॉप्टर)** - An aircraft that derives its lift from blades that rotate about an approximately vertical central axis. 
 
• **Ladybug (लेडीबग)** - A small round bright-coloured and spotted beetle that usually feeds on aphids and other insect pests.
 
 

203:Tb8b,

The correct answer is Option 2 i.e.
